title: Asset registry: every model, animation, sound and texture the game uses, with its spec, current placeholder, source and license.

status.description: needed = the real asset does not exist and no stand-in is in the game yet; placeholder = a labelled stand-in is in the game; final = the real asset is in.

spec.description: What the final asset must be (style, size, budget, rig, length...).

placeholder.description: The labelled stand-in the game uses (or will use) until the real asset exists.

source.description: Where the stand-in (or, once final, the real asset) comes from.

license.description: License of the stand-in (or, once final, the real asset).
